title: Teapot with cozy
text: Teapot with cozy. This teapot is perfect for one person.  Holds about 3 or small 4 cups.  I love the stainless steel tea strainer (built into center - but removable).  While I usually use teabags, I have a couple of teas that I buy loose.  The lid holds nicely with the center piece, which is also removable making for easy cleaning, however, you cannot use the lid without the center piece - just fyi.  It comes with a neoprin like "cozy" that keeps the tea hot just a little longer... it zips on and off for cleaning as well. I haven't washed the cozy, but... I think you could gentle wash it. I would use an unscented detergent - that I keep for such uses - that way no laundry perfumes to spoil your tea experience.  I noticed that pouring the tea that sometimes the zipper tongue gets in the way so, I just zipped it the other way - zipper tongue down and that solved that.  The clear glass is fairly tough... but I wouldn't bang it around.  I top shelf it in the dishwasher with no issues.  It is just a terrific little teapot in my opinion. That being said, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
